FEAT-1-STORY-017.title: Define facade-level provider search contract
FEAT-1-STORY-017.description: Establish request/response contract in find_care_facade to standardize inputs (query, location, specialty hints) and outputs (ranked providers, metadata, fallback indicators) for downstream tool_router consumption.

FEAT-1-STORY-018.title: Implement vector search with taxonomy fallback sequencing
FEAT-1-STORY-018.description: Enhance provider_search_service to enforce deterministic sequencing: attempt vector search first, detect low-confidence or empty results, then trigger taxonomy-based fallback using NUCC codes with merged ranking.

FEAT-1-STORY-019.title: Expose provider search via tool_router API
FEAT-1-STORY-019.description: Wire provider search capability into tool_router allowlist, ensuring validated inputs are routed to find_care_facade and results are returned in tool_use compatible format for LLM orchestration.

FEAT-1-STORY-020.title: Validate location filtering and geo enrichment logic
FEAT-1-STORY-020.description: Test and refine location filtering pipeline including FIPS-to-county mapping, city/state resolution, and distance constraints to ensure accurate geographic narrowing of provider results.
